grid.layout_notes: 4-4-4-4-4 across 5 reels with Ritual Bar on the bottom row. Cursed Spins expands to a 5×5 reel with only high-paying symbols.

win_system.notes: Official site summary: 1024 base ways; xSplit during Cursed Spins multiplies symbol size / ways.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Winning combinations are destroyed and remaining symbols tumble down; new symbols fall in.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: Cursed Spins: reel area becomes 5×5 with only high-paying symbols; Ritual Bar removed.

other.name: Ritual Bar
other.how_it_works: 5 progression levels (thresholds 20/30/40/60/80). Resets each level-up; excess carries over. Medium wins +1/symbol, high +2/symbol, Scatter +10. Each level removes lowest paying symbol and converts medium→high.

other.name: Sticky Wild
other.how_it_works: Wilds on reels 2–5. In Candle/Cursed Spins, Wild drops to bottom and stays sticky until part of a win or a new bet.

wilds.name: Sticky Wild
wilds.behavior: Lands on reels 2–5. During Candle Spins / Cursed Spins drops to bottom of reel and remains sticky until it is part of a winning combination or a new bet is made.

scatters.name: Scatter
scatters.behavior: Advances Ritual Bar by +10 each. During Cursed Spins, landing a Scatter gives +1 free spin.

specials.name: xSplit
specials.behavior: Active during Cursed Spins. Splits either the row or the reel; multiplies symbol size by 2. Multiple xSplits can land on the same row but not the same reel.

base_game_loop.summary: Paid tumble spin on 4-4-4-4-4 (1024 ways) with Ritual Bar progression. Medium/high wins and Scatters fill the bar through 5 levels (20/30/40/60/80), removing low pays and upgrading medium→high. Level-ups award Candle Spins (+2 until level 4); level 5 enters Cursed Spins (+6 FS, 5×5 high-pays only, xSplit). Optional buys: Baphomet Rite / Cursed Spins / Nolimit Bonus 55–500×.

phases.name: Spin & tumble
phases.what_happens: Spin 4-4-4-4-4. Pay ways wins; destroy winners; tumble until no wins. Sticky Wilds may land on reels 2–5.

phases.name: Ritual Bar progress
phases.what_happens: Add bar progress: medium winning symbols +1 each, high +2 each, Scatter +10 each. On threshold, level up: remove lowest pay, convert medium→high; carry excess; pay any pending wins before level change.

phases.name: Award spins from level-up
phases.what_happens: New level (until 4) awards +2 Candle Spins. Advancing to level 5 / Cursed Spins awards +6 free spins and switches to Cursed mode.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Ways wins paid each tumble; Ritual Bar collects after wins; level-ups happen after plausible wins pay out.
base_game_loop.notes: No public GameSheet PDF on site (documents.gameSheet=null); mechanics from official CMS feature descriptions on nolimitcity.com/games/blood-and-shadow.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
## Reel Area & Ritual Bar
The reel setup is 4-4-4-4-4 rows across 5 reels with a Ritual bar at the bottom row.
Winning combinations will be destroyed and remaining symbols will tumble down, allowing the new symbols to fall in.
At the Ritual Bar, there are 5 levels of progression. The Ritual Bar resets for each level-up. Exceeding collects are carried over to the next level.
- Level 1: 20 - Level 2: 30 - Level 3: 40 - Level 4: 60 - Level 5: 80
Landing the Scatter Symbols and winning combinations of medium and high paying symbols advances the Ritual Bar.
- Medium paying symbol = +1 per winning symbol - High paying symbol = +2 per winning symbol
- Scatter Symbol = +10 per Scatter symbol
Each level removes the lowest paying symbol and also converts medium symbols to high paying symbols.

## Candle Spins
Reaching a new level of the Ritual Bar awards +2 Candle Spins till level 4.
+6 Freespins are awarded when advancing to Cursed Spins.
Before any new level, any plausible wins pays out before progressing to the next level. During Candle Spins, the Ritual bar performs the same as in the base game.

## Sticky Wild
Sticky Wilds can only land on reel 2-5.

# Blood & Shadow summary

Enter the dark and forbidden world of an abandoned cathedral in Blood & Shadow. Nolimit City invites you to join Shadow Girl as she performs a demonic ritual for eternal youth. The eerie action takes place on a five reel, four row grid that offers 1024 base ways to win, but the board can expand as the ritual progresses. If you are brave enough to face the underworld without spending any actual cash, you can [play for free](https://playin.com/games/blood-and-shadow) right here on Playin.com.

## Base Game Mechanics and Features

The base game is fueled by a tumbling mechanic where winning combinations disappear so new symbols can fall into place. Every time you score a win with medium or high paying symbols, or land a scatter, you feed the Ritual Bar located at the bottom of the screen. Advancing through the five levels of the Ritual Bar removes lower paying symbols and converts medium symbols into high paying demonic entities. You will also encounter Sticky Wilds that drop to the bottom of the grid and remain there until they contribute to a winning connection.
